title: Modalites d'inscriptions selon les courses — Marathon du Mont-Blanc
claims: The organiser states that entry to the Mont-Blanc Marathon races is online only, paid by bank card.
For the 90 km, 42 km, 23 km and Duo Etoile, 10% of bibs are reserved for residents of the Chamonix valley travelling by train, bus, on foot or by bike, with no lottery.
A further 40% of bibs are reserved for runners coming by train or bus, also without a lottery, on a first-come-first-served basis.
The remaining 50% of bibs are allocated by a free lottery; a runner may enter only one of the four races subject to the lottery.
The page states that entry is firm and definitive with no refund for any reason, except through cancellation insurance taken out at registration.
The page states that payment of carbon compensation for travel to and from Chamonix is mandatory regardless of bib type, and that proof of address must be uploaded at registration.
The registration procedure and its dates on this page are those used for the 2026 edition (October 2025 opening), not a published 2027 procedure.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直取官网报名方式页。页面日期为 2025 年 10 月（对应 2026 届），与首页所说 2027 报名 2026 年 11 月开放不是同一轮流程。

页面所列开放日期为 'lundi 20 octobre 2025'、'mercredi 22 octobre 2025'、'jeudi 23 octobre 2025'，属 2026 届流程。
